[[Boss/Legends|Boss]] '''Uruli''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Uruli appeared as a non-player character in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
